coverage_note: Opinions come from a seller-published review and a small number of XHS posts and comments from 2026, mostly short mainland-China owner and builder remarks. They are too few for a summary and may skew toward enthusiastic early owners.

opinions.title: KUNG MACH Aero Frameset Review
opinions.configuration: Size-M white frameset built with 105 Di2 and FARSPORTS C6EVO wheels at 7.3 kg.
opinions.summary: Calls the MACH a pure aero race bike whose defining trait is stiffness and very direct power transfer, with balanced, predictable cornering and a firm but not harsh ride. The weighed 1,150 g frame is heavy, only a 10 mm-offset seatpost is offered, and the bar-end plugs are non-round.

opinions.title: 攻队马赫，聊聊我的国产公路车
opinions.summary: The owner says the bike was designed by racers and mechanics and that its details are well thought out, making it a satisfying frame for a mechanic to assemble.

opinions.title: 攻队马赫
opinions.configuration: Two builds assembled by this builder: size L with 105 Di2 R7170 and size XS with 105 R7120.
opinions.summary: Both builds came in just under 8 kg. Internal routing was far easier than on other brands this builder has assembled, even with four cables for R7120, because the matching bar has large routing openings; the builder also likes the wide fork and head tube.

opinions.title: 车架 KUNG Mach vs BROSS Vagabond aero (comment)
opinions.configuration: MACH rider answering a frame-choice question; build not stated.
opinions.summary: In reply to a MACH versus BROSS Vagabond Aero question, this rider says the MACH is very stiff, while declining to judge the BROSS frame they have not ridden.

opinions.title: 车架 KUNG Mach vs BROSS Vagabond aero (comment)
opinions.summary: This owner reports that the MACH fork feels soft when sprinting out of the saddle and that the disc rotor rubs. It is a single report without measurement or wheel details.
